svg.title: Crosstalk onto SEL and WRITE during a simple card's read
svg.desc: The card's two ABT245 transceivers in DIP drive D0 to D15 low together, typical corner, calibrated model. SEL and WRITE at the card's 74HCT132 inputs, against the card's ground, with the guard ground pins and without them.
svg.text: Ground pins around SEL and WRITE
